messages:
maria (support): Hey — multiple customers reporting their token-cost dashboard shows $0 or NaN for the last 48h. Examples: org 5421, org 7718. Charts show NaN in the hourly rows and total = $0.
liam (eng-telemetry): Thanks Maria. Is this scoped to Hosted only or Dedicated as well? Any recent deploys to telemetry/billing? :eyes:
maria (support): Only seeing Hosted so far (prod). Reported after yesterday's midnight window. No dedicated reports yet.
nate (eng-data): We ran the ledger->analytics join migration at 00:15 UTC yesterday (rolling). Could be related. Can you paste one affected org id + time range?
maria (support): Org 5421, range 2026-03-15 00:00 -> 2026-03-16 23:59 UTC. Customer says token usage exists in ledger but dashboard shows zeros. I grabbed a quick ledger snippet: `ledger.rows where org_id = 5421 and ts >= '2026-03-15'` returns token rows.
liam (eng-telemetry): Can you check raw metrics view? Run `SELECT * FROM analytics.costs_hourly WHERE org_id=5421 ORDER BY hour DESC LIMIT 5;` — want to see if sums are NULL or 0.
maria (support): Ran that and pasted output: 
```
hour | tokens | cost
2026-03-16T23:00Z | 1200 | NaN
2026-03-16T22:00Z | 0 | 0
2026-03-16T21:00Z | 950 | NaN
```
(so some hours show NaN, some 0)
Emma (billing): NaN in cost columns usually means the pipeline produced `NULL` and frontend converted to NaN. Did the schema change for `cost_components`?
nate (eng-data): Looking at the join, we changed the price_key from `model_id` to `pricing_key_v2` during migration. If there are rows with missing pricing_key_v2 the join could produce NULL cost. The pipeline should `COALESCE(sum(cost),0)` but the new job forgot that for reserved_capacity rows.
liam (eng-telemetry): Yep I see it in the migration diff: `sum(cost)` replaced earlier `coalesce(sum(cost),0)` in analytics builder. That explains NaN in hourly aggregation and 0 in totals where later stage casts NULL->0.
maria (support): Ok — what's the user impact? Do we have customers seeing billing invoices wrong or only dashboard visualization?
Emma (billing): Billing ledger (invoices) uses raw ledger records and is unaffected. This is dashboard/analytics only. Still high-priority for affected customers.
liam (eng-telemetry): Quick mitigation: revert the aggregation to coalesce in the streaming builder and hotfix deploy. Then schedule a backfill re-aggregation job for the window 2026-03-15 -> 2026-03-16. Proposed immediate steps:
- deploy hotfix to telemetry builder (adds COALESCE) — ETA 30m
- run backfill job `analytics:recalc_costs --start 2026-03-15 --end 2026-03-16 --orgs 5421,7718` targeting only affected orgs first — ETA 2h
- run full backfill for last 7 days overnight if snapshots look good — ETA 6h
nate (eng-data): Backfill command (internal):
```
# runs on airflow -> dag analytics.recalc_costs
{ "start_date": "2026-03-15T00:00:00Z", "end_date": "2026-03-16T23:59:59Z", "org_filter": [5421,7718], "reaggregate": true }
```
liam (eng-telemetry): I'll open a rollback PR and a hotfix PR and pin the builders. If deploy fails we can revert the migration. @ops-bot can you run a canary with org 5421 once deployed? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
ops-bot: Canary test queued: analytics.builder.hotfix -> canary org 5421 -> notify #eng-oncall on completion.
maria (support): I'll message the affected customers with a short note — "we see an analytics display bug affecting cost widget, not your invoices, fix in progress, expected correction within a few hours".
Emma (billing): Please list the affected orgs in the customer note. Also add a support follow-up if they ask for credits (billing unaffected but perception matters).
liam (eng-telemetry): Hotfix PR: https://git.redwood/telemetry/commit/abc123 (adds coalesce). Deploying to prod now.
liam (eng-telemetry): Deploy succeeded. Starting backfill for orgs 5421,7718 now. Will report progress + final checks.
ops-bot: Backfill job started (job id 98765). ETA ~18m for two orgs.
liam (eng-telemetry): Backfill completed for the two orgs. Sample query now returns:
```
hour | tokens | cost
2026-03-16T23:00Z | 1200 | 24.48
2026-03-16T22:00Z | 0 | 0
2026-03-16T21:00Z | 950 | 19.36
```
Looks fixed for sampled hours.
maria (support): Thanks all — I'll close customer tickets with the update and ask them to refresh dashboards. Anyone want me to keep this thread open for postmortem notes?
nate (eng-data): Keep it open. We'll create a postmortem and include root cause: migrated aggregation lost COALESCE for null-prone join. Also add a test in staging to ensure NaN->0 is validated for cost aggregates.
liam (eng-telemetry): Filed postmortem ticket: PM-6421. Assigning to eng-data and telemetry.
maria (support): Great. Closing customer-facing loop. :white_check_mark:
